title: VPC probe suite: latency/error/saturation/token-throughput SLO probes and safe upgrade path
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Add a standardized, configurable probe suite for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments that measures latency p99/p95, request error rates, saturation (CPU/GPU/queue depth), and token throughput, exposes those probes to the control plane and Terraform modules, and provides a safe upgrade/rollback path for agents and runtime components.
acceptance_criteria: Health probe library added to private agent with toggles for: latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), request error rate (4xx/5xx), saturation metrics (CPU/GPU util, queue depth), token throughput per-second.
Terraform module exposes probe configuration (thresholds, scrape intervals, alert policies) as input variables and applies without drift during a module upgrade.
Control plane dashboards show probe-derived SLOs for each VPC deployment and surface violations tied to deployment IDs and model routes.
Automated canary upgrade workflow uses probe signals to pause/rollback upgrades when SLOs breach configured thresholds for >=2 minutes during rollout.
End-to-end test (integration) validates probe metrics are reported for synthetic load and that Terraform plan/apply does not break probe-related resources.
Documentation and runbook added for on-call: how to interpret probe failures and execute manual rollback if automation fails.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Design probe schema and export format (prometheus metrics + structured labels: deployment_id, node_role, model_version, route)
Phase 2: Implement probe collectors in private agent and runtime shim (safe sampling to avoid adding tail latency), add config flags to agent config and env variables.
Phase 3: Terraform: add module variables for probe toggles, threshold defaults, and Prometheus scrape job resources or cloud metrics export integration.
Phase 4: Control plane: ingest probe metrics, compute SLO windows (1m, 5m, 1h), add alert rules and rollout guard integration.
Phase 5: Upgrade procedure: implement canary/gradual rollout that relies on probe checks; build CLI tool to force-advance/pause rollouts; add automatic rollback on sustained SLO breach.
Phase 6: Integration tests and a staged rollout to internal staging VPCs, then pilot with two customers on dedicated private deployments.
Phase 7: Docs, runbooks, postmortem templates and playbook for on-call.
updates: 2026-02-26: Ticket created by Asha to centralize VPC health probes across Terraform, agent, and control plane. Linked to ENG-4702 (private deployment infra epic).

2026-03-01: Design sync with Monitoring and Runtime teams. Decided on Prometheus-compatible metrics + structured labels. Trade-off: avoid histogram for every latency bucket to reduce cardinality; use p95/p99 percentiles via client-side sliding window aggregator.

2026-03-04: Proof-of-concept agent collector implemented (Liam). Collector computes p50/p95/p99 using t-digest and emits summary metrics every 15s. Added flag --probe-sample-rate with default 1.0 (can reduce to 0.1 for heavy nodes).

2026-03-07: Terraform module draft created (PR #3421). Exposes variables: probe_enabled, latency_thresholds_ms, error_rate_threshold, saturation_thresholds, scrape_interval_seconds. Initial default thresholds are conservative.

2026-03-09: Monitoring reviewed PR. Concern raised: default scrape interval 15s may be too aggressive for high-cardinality labels; agreed to 30s for control-plane defaults, allow 15s for high-SLO customers. Action: add terraform var scrape_interval_override with validation.

2026-03-11: Rollout guard prototype integrated into the Canary controller. Canary pauses when any configured SLO (latency p99 or error rate) is breached for two consecutive windows. Implementation uses PromQL-based checks. Liam filed ENG-4930 to generalize controller checks.

2026-03-12: Integration tests added to CI pipeline: synthetic load generator validates token throughput metric and triggers a simulated SLO breach to confirm automatic rollback. Tests flaky on initial run; root cause: test VM clock drift affecting aggregation windows. Fix: pin time sync and extend test windows by +5s.

2026-03-14: Security review kickoff scheduled. KMS team asked whether metrics contain sensitive ids; decision: deployment_id is hashed before export to global control plane while full ID is kept in customer VPC. Liam to add hash function and document it.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: High cardinality labels could overwhelm Prometheus and increase cost. Mitigation: limit label set to deployment_id (hashed), node_role, model_family; avoid per-route labels by default unless opt-in.

Risk: Probe collectors add CPU work and might affect tail latency. Mitigation: sampling controls, offloading heavy aggregation to a sidecar thread, and allowing probe CPU cgroup reservations in Terraform.

Risk: Terraform upgrades could remove monitoring resources unexpectedly. Mitigation: add acceptance test that runs terraform plan and asserts no deletions for probe-related resources during upgrade; also add lifecycle ignore_changes where appropriate.
Risk: Automated rollback may oscillate during transient blips. Mitigation: require 2 consecutive windows and backoff policy before rollback; add manual override to continue rollout.
notes: Keep defaults conservative for GA — prefer fewer false positives and give customers clear instructions to tighten thresholds.
Coordinate with Sales/CS for pilot customers so we can test rolling upgrades and rollback in production settings with real traffic patterns.
Follow up (post-GA): evaluate using adaptive thresholds based on historical baseline per-deployment to reduce noise.
